title: Conversion of Roux-en-Y gastric bypass to single anastomosis duodenal ileal bypass
author: Dib, Madalosso, et al.
materials: The Petersen space is kept open;•
The remaining alimentary limb from RYGB is resected;•
The anastomosis integrity is tested with methylene blue;•

The use of Gastrogastric Jejunal Bridge can be a reasonable tactic to convert RYGB to SADI-S, in case of weight regain. Furthermore, this maneuver could facilitate the conversion of RYGB to other bariatric techniques in which the sleeve is one of the surgical steps (Sleeve plus) or even for the isolated Sleeve itself.

steps.title: Identify anatomical landmarks
steps.instruction: Locate the gastro‑entero anastomosis, the left hepatic lobe, and the alimentary limb of the previous bypass; then identify the cecum, measure 300 cm of ileal limb proximally from the ileal cecal valve (ICV), fix this segment to the greater omentum with a knot and clip, and count the remaining limbs.

steps.title: Perform cholecystectomy and candy‑cane resection
steps.instruction: Carry out a laparoscopic cholecystectomy for chronic cholecystitis and resect the redundant “candy‑cane” jejunal limb.

steps.title: Transect alimentary limb
steps.instruction: Identify the alimentary limb up to the gastro‑jejunal (GJ) anastomosis and transect it 8 cm distal to the GJ anastomosis.

steps.title: Resect remnant stomach
steps.instruction: Dissect the remnant stomach down to the antrum and transect it horizontally 3 cm above the pylorus.

steps.title: Create jejuno‑antral anastomosis
steps.instruction: Perform a mechanical stapled anastomosis between the proximal alimentary limb and the posterior wall of the antrum; close the staple line with a single‑layer 3‑0 PDS suture.

steps.title: Preserve duodenal blood supply and transect duodenum
steps.instruction: Preserve the antropyloric and proximal duodenal arterial arcade, then dissect and transect the duodenum 3 cm distal to the pylorus.

steps.title: Construct duodeno‑ileal anastomosis
steps.instruction: Release the previously fixed ileal limb from the greater omentum and create a 2‑cm duodeno‑ileal anastomosis using two continuous layers of 3‑0 PDS sutures.

steps.title: Leave Petersen space open
steps.instruction: Do not close the Petersen space; keep it open.

steps.title: Resect remaining alimentary limb
steps.instruction: Resect the remaining alimentary limb from the original RYGB.

steps.title: Test anastomosis integrity
steps.instruction: Inject methylene blue to verify the integrity of all anastomoses.

steps.title: Extract specimens
steps.instruction: Place the excluded stomach and resected alimentary limb into an endobag and remove them through an enlarged left hypochondrium incision.

steps.title: Close incisions and remove trocars
steps.instruction: Remove all trocars, close the aponeurosis at the 12 mm trocar sites and at the enlarged wound, suture the skin, and leave no drains.
